items.title: Carl Rinker Interview, 1962-10-14
items.q: I think Carol Dickerson went to the Regal. Uh well Savoy I mean the Savoy Ballroom.

ctx.x: that group now. You're quite sure they were here at the time at the time. Yes he was there. Uh there was

another drummer. I can't remember his name. Uh I used to meet Earl and uh Louie Armstrong after they finished work and we would just bum around a little bit together. Chatted up a bit here and there. That was back when Louie was playing at the uh Sunset and later at the Grand Terrace. Uh Earl was at the Grand Terrace and Louie was at the Regal I believe. I think Carol Dickerson went to the Regal. Uh well Savoy I mean the Savoy Ballroom. Savoy Ballroom. And we used to hear Clarence Williams play at the Vendome…

I'd like to have. You said the spot on North Broadway. Someplace around. In Argyle. That would make it a place that he played for a few nights. Yes. With uh Darnell Howard and I think Ewell and and you encountered them there. You were in. Yes I was asked to go there one night with my horn. I went
